enrollment.description: Undergraduate certificate/degree-seeking enrollment, not total institutional enrollment.

tuitionIn.description: Annual in-state tuition and required fees in USD; excludes living costs and financial aid.

tuitionOut.description: Annual out-of-state tuition and required fees in USD; excludes living costs and financial aid.

admissionRate.description: Admissions rate as a fraction from 0 to 1; absence does not imply open admission.

graduationRate.description: Completion within 150% of normal time for first-time full-time students, as a fraction from 0 to 1. See graduationRateMetric.

C150_4.reportingPeriod: Fall 2019 or AcadYr 2019-20 cohort (differs by institutional calendar), reported in IPEDS DCY2025-26

C150_L4.reportingPeriod: Fall 2022 or AcadYr 2022-23 cohort (differs by institutional calendar), reported in IPEDS DCY2025-26

coverage: Active IPEDS institutions open to the public in the 50 states, DC, U.S. territories and freely associated states; includes degree, certificate, vocational and graduate institutions. Administrative units, closed/combined records and child campuses reporting through a parent are excluded.
limitations: IPEDS coverage is not every U.S. postsecondary provider; new and nonparticipating institutions may be absent.
Directory and statistics are historical snapshots, not live current offerings or prices.
Scorecard statistics are joined only by exact UNITID. Missing, suppressed and nonnumeric values are omitted.
No majors, admissions deadlines, rankings, accreditation claims or application requirements are inferred.
